name: kaijan
description: Understand your application, plan tests and review results with Kaijan.

defaultPrompt: Use Kaijan to plan tests for this work item.
Use Kaijan to run the saved tests on my app and show the results.
Use Kaijan to retest the failed tests after the fix.
interface.longDescription:
Use Kaijan in chat to understand an application, assess changes and run test scenarios.

Start with a message:

• Use Kaijan to plan tests for this work item.

• Use Kaijan to run the saved tests on my app and show the results.

• Use Kaijan to retest the failed tests after the fix.

Select Try now to start a chat, then send one of these messages or describe your own goal. Kaijan will ask for the missing repository, change or test details.

Some actions need a connection. You can save your goal during Setup and connect before testing.
